أنخرط (form VII)
# أَنْخَرِطُ (ʔanḵariṭu) /ʔan.xa.ri.tˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
# أَنْخَرِطَ (ʔanḵariṭa) /ʔan.xa.ri.tˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
# أَنْخَرِطْ (ʔanḵariṭ) /ʔan.xa.ritˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
